Set coordinates:
\[
A=(0,0),\quad B=(28,0).
\]
Since \(AC=37,\ BC=33\), solving gives
\[
C=(19,12\sqrt7).
\]

The angle bisector direction from \(A\) is the sum of unit vectors along \(AB\) and \(AC\):
\[
(1,0)+\frac{(19,12\sqrt7)}{37}
=\left(\frac{56}{37},\frac{12\sqrt7}{37}\right),
\]
so \(AD\) has direction
\[
(14,3\sqrt7).
\]

\(E\) is the foot of \(B=(28,0)\) onto the line through \(A\) in direction \(v=(14,3\sqrt7)\):
\[
E=\frac{B\cdot v}{v\cdot v}v
=\frac{392}{259}(14,3\sqrt7)
=\left(\frac{784}{37},\frac{168\sqrt7}{37}\right).
\]

\(F\) is the midpoint of \(AB\), so
\[
F=(14,0).
\]

Thus
\[
EF^2=\left(\frac{784}{37}-14\right)^2+\left(\frac{168\sqrt7}{37}\right)^2
=\left(\frac{266}{37}\right)^2+\left(\frac{168\sqrt7}{37}\right)^2
=196.
\]
Therefore
\[
\boxed{14}
\]
